title: Doozy Vape Co Big Drip Cherry Cola Bottles Shortfill E-Liquid 100ml
description: A sweet shop classic, this delicious eliquid perfectly captures the puckish tang of cherry candy swirled into dark, sugary cola. This convenient 100ml shortfill bottle really helps your favourite e-liquid go the distance and comes with 25ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mods and sub-ohm tanks .
